title: Return a safe 503 JSON envelope when the database is unreachable

scope_out: Structured request logging as a deliverable (SG-11)

entities.name: Return a safe 503 JSON envelope when the database is unreachable

files: ) with no stack trace/class name/path, when
operations.text:
1. Create `backend/src/api/error_handlers.py` — global exception handler returning a 503 `ErrorBody` (`{"error": ...}`) with no stack trace/class name/path, when `check_db_reachable()` fails.
2. Extend `backend/src/types/models.py` — reuse `ErrorBody` (already added by E6-S1's health work).
3. Extend `backend/src/main.py` — register the global exception handler.
4. Add `backend/tests/integration/test_error_handling.py` covering AC1–AC3.
